name: BABY MONSTER
description: BABYMONSTER is a fierce, hip-hop-centric k-pop girl group.
details: BABYMONSTER is a multinational seven-member k-pop girl group formed by YG Entertainment. The septet consists of Ruka, Pharita, Asa, Ahyeon, Rami, Rora, and Chiquita. They officially debuted as a full ensemble on April 1, 2024, with their mini-album BABYMONS7ER.

name: BLACKPINK
description: Blackpink is a globally acclaimed South Korean girl group.
details: BLACKPINK is a record-breaking South Korean girl group formed by YG Entertainment, consisting of members Jisoo, Jennie, Rosé, and Lisa. Since debuting in 2016, they have become global fashion icons and the highest-charting female Korean act on the Billboard Hot 100.

name: BTS
description: RM, Jin, Suga, J-Hope, Jimin, V, and Jungkook.
details: BTS is a famous seven-member South Korean music band that officially debuted on June 13, 2013. Known as the Bangtan Boys, they mix pop and hip-hop with deep messages about self-love. Their massive global fan base is called ARMY.

name: ENHYPEN
description: ENHYPEN is a powerful, dark-fantasy-themed k-pop boy group.
details: ENHYPEN is a South Korean boy band formed by Belift Lab through the 2020 reality show I-Land. The group currently consists of six members: Jungwon, Jay, Jake, Sunghoon, Sunoo, and Ni-ki. They debuted on November 30, 2020.

name: EXO
description: EXO is a legendary South Korean-Chinese boy band.
details: EXO is a highly successful South Korean-Chinese boy band formed by SM Entertainment in 2011. Debuting in 2012, the group originally consisted of 12 members. Renowned as the Kings of K-pop, they popularized multi-concept storytelling.

name: (G)I-DLE
description: (G)I-DLE is a self-producing, concept-driven k-pop girl group.
details: (G)I-DLE is a popular five-member South Korean girl group under Cube Entertainment that debuted in 2018. The group consists of Miyeon, Minnie, Soyeon, Yuqi, and Shuhua. Known as self-producing idols, they write and produce their own music.

name: IVE
description: IVE is a popular six-member South Korean girl group.
details: IVE is a prominent South Korean girl group formed by Starship Entertainment. Debuting in December 2021 with the hit single Eleven, the six-member lineup includes An Yujin, Gaeul, Rei, Jang Wonyoung, Liz, and Leeseo.

name: NCT
description: NCT is a South Korean boy band.
details: NCT (Neo Culture Technology) is a South Korean boy band formed by SM Entertainment. Known for their unique unlimited member concept, the group features members divided into several distinct sub-units including NCT U, NCT 127, NCT Dream, WayV, and NCT Wish.

name: NEWJEANS
description: NewJeans is a trendsetting, Y2K-inspired k-pop girl group.
details: NewJeans is a highly influential South Korean girl group formed by ADOR. Debuting in 2022, they revolutionized k-pop with their effortless, Y2K-inspired aesthetic and 1990s-style R&B music. Known for massive hits like Ditto and Hype Boy.

name: RIIZE
description: RIIZE is a six-member South Korean boy band.
details: RIIZE is a South Korean boy band formed by SM Entertainment. They debuted on September 4, 2023, with the single album Get a Guitar. The group features six members: Shotaro, Eunseok, Sungchan, Wonbin, Sohee, and Anton.

name: STRAY KIDS
description: Stray Kids is a popular eight-member South Korean boy band.
details: Stray Kids is an eight-member South Korean boy band formed by JYP Entertainment through a 2017 reality survival show. Officially debuting on March 25, 2018, the group is globally renowned for its distinct, high-energy sound and self-producing unit 3RACHA.

name: TWICE
description: Twice is a famous nine-member South Korean girl group.
details: TWICE is a globally successful South Korean girl group formed by JYP Entertainment in 2015 through the reality show Sixteen. The group consists of nine members: Nayeon, Jeongyeon, Momo, Sana, Jihyo, Mina, Dahyun, Chaeyoung, and Tzuyu.

name: T-ARA
description: T-ara is a popular South Korean girl group.
details: T-ara is a South Korean girl group formed by MBK Entertainment in 2009. Known as the chameleons of k-pop, they are famous for their catchy, dance-pop hits like Roly-Poly, Bo Peep Bo Peep, and Lovey-Dovey.

name: TXT
description: TXT is a five-member South Korean boy group.
details: TXT, short for Tomorrow X Together, is a five-member South Korean boy band formed by Big Hit Music in 2019. The group consists of members Soobin, Yeonjun, Beomgyu, Taehyun, and Huening Kai.

name: ATTACK ON TITAN
description: Humanity fights for survival against giant humanoid Titans behind massive walls.
details: Attack on Titan follows Eren Yeager and his friends as they join the Survey Corps to fight the Titans that threaten humanity's existence behind the walls.

name: DEATH NOTE
description: A high school student finds a notebook that can kill anyone whose name is written in it.
details: Death Note follows Light Yagami, who discovers a supernatural notebook that allows him to kill anyone by writing their name. He begins a quest to create a new world free of crime, while being pursued by the genius detective L.

name: DEMON SLAYER
description: Tanjiro Kamado becomes a demon slayer to save his sister and avenge his family.
details: Demon Slayer follows Tanjiro Kamado, who becomes a demon slayer after his family is slaughtered and his sister Nezuko is turned into a demon. He joins the Demon Slayer Corps to find a cure for Nezuko and defeat the demons.

name: DEVIL MAY CRY
description: Dante battles demons in stylish action-packed adventures.
details: Devil May Cry follows Dante,a demon hunter who runs the Devil May Cry agency, as he battles powerful demons with style and skill.

name: DRAGON BALL
description: Goku's adventures to become the strongest fighter in the universe.
details: Dragon Ball follows Son Goku from childhood through his many adventures, tournaments, and battles to protect Earth and become stronger.

name: JUJUTSU KAISEN
description: Yuji Itadori joins a secret organization of Jujutsu Sorcerers to fight cursed spirits.
details: Jujutsu Kaisen follows Yuji Itadori, who swallows a cursed object and becomes host to the powerful curse Sukuna. He joins Tokyo Jujutsu High to fight cursed spirits.

name: NARUTO
description: A young ninja seeks recognition and dreams of becoming Hokage.
details: Naruto follows Naruto Uzumaki, a young ninja who dreams of becoming the strongest ninja and leader of his village, the Hokage, while containing the Nine-Tailed Fox within him.

name: TOKYO GHOUL
description: Ken Kaneki becomes a half-ghoul and struggles between two worlds.
details: Tokyo Ghoul follows Ken Kaneki, who becomes a half-ghoul after a chance encounter and must navigate the dangerous world of ghouls while trying to retain his humanity.

name: ONE PIECE
description: Monkey D. Luffy sets sail to become the King of the Pirates.
details: One Piece follows Monkey D. Luffy and his crew, the Straw Hat Pirates, as they search for the legendary treasure One Piece to make Luffy the King of the Pirates.

name: ONE PUNCH MAN
description: Saitama is a hero who can defeat any opponent with a single punch.
details: One Punch Man follows Saitama, a hero who has grown bored after becoming so powerful that he can defeat any enemy with one punch. He seeks a worthy opponent while dealing with the Hero Association.

name: VAGABOND
description: The life of legendary swordsman Miyamoto Musashi.
details: Vagabond is a fictionalized account of the life of Miyamoto Musashi, one of Japan's most famous swordsmen, based on the novel Musashi by Eiji Yoshikawa.

name: VINLAND SAGA
description: A young Viking seeks revenge and discovers a greater purpose.
details: Vinland Saga follows Thorfinn, a young Viking warrior seeking revenge for his father's death, who eventually discovers a path beyond violence toward a peaceful land called Vinland.

name: BLUE BOX
description: A high school romance centered around badminton and basketball.
details: Blue Box follows Taiki Inomata, a badminton player who falls for basketball star Chinatsu Hoshino after she transfers to his school and starts living at his family's dojo.

name: DANDADAN
description: A boy who believes in aliens and a girl who believes in ghosts team up against supernatural threats.
details: Dandadan follows Momo Ayase and Ken Takakura (Okarun) as they investigate the occult and face both ghosts and aliens in wild, action-packed adventures.

name: ARMY OF THIEVES
description: A skilled safecracker joins a team for a daring heist across Europe.
details: Army of Thieves is a 2021 romantic comedy heist film directed by and starring Matthias Schweighöfer. Serving as a prequel to Army of the Dead,the story follows a small-town bank teller, Dieter, who is recruited to crack three legendary high-security safes across Europe.

name: DEADPOOL 2
description: A wisecracking antihero seeks revenge after a dangerous experiment changes his life.
details: Deadpool 2 is a 2018 superhero comedy film starring Ryan Reynolds as Wade Wilson. After a personal tragedy, Deadpool forms a ragtag team of mutants called the X-Force to protect a young mutant from Cable, a time-traveling cyborg.

name: DEMON CITY
description: A former hitman fights back against a criminal organization after losing everything.
details: Demon City (2025) is an ultra-violent Japanese action thriller on Netflix. It follows Shūhei Sakata, an ex-hitman who awakens from a 12-year coma and unleashes a brutal quest for revenge against the syndicate that murdered his family.

name: ESCAPE ROOM
description: Six strangers must solve deadly puzzles to survive a mysterious escape room.
details: The 2019 psychological thriller Escape Room follows six strangers invited to compete for a $10,000 prize. They soon discover the rooms contain deadly traps tied to their past traumas.

name: FRANKENSTEIN
description: A brilliant scientist creates a mysterious creature with terrifying consequences.
details: The classic 1931 horror film Frankenstein follows Dr. Henry Frankenstein as he assembles a human body from stolen corpse parts and brings it to life, with tragic results.

name: I WANT TO EAT YOUR PANCREAS
description: A quiet boy discovers a secret about his classmate and forms an unforgettable bond.
details: I Want to Eat Your Pancreas is a 2018 anime film. An introverted boy discovers his bubbly classmate Sakura has a terminal pancreatic disease. They grow close, sharing her final months together.

name: SPIDER-MAN: HOMECOMING
description: Peter Parker balances high school life while learning to become a real superhero.
details: In Spider-Man: Homecoming (2017), 15-year-old Peter Parker balances high school life in Queens with his secret superhero identity while fighting The Vulture under the guidance of Tony Stark.

name: JURASSIC WORLD
description: A dinosaur theme park turns into a deadly fight for survival.
details: Jurassic World (2015) is set on the fully functioning dinosaur theme park Isla Nublar. Chaos erupts when a genetically modified predator, the Indominus rex, escapes.

name: MERCY FOR NONE
description: A former gangster returns to settle a personal score and uncover the truth.
details: Mercy for None is a 2025 South Korean action-noir series on Netflix. It stars So Ji-sub as Nam Gi-jun, a former gang enforcer who returns to Seoul to seek revenge for his younger brother's murder.

name: MONEY HEIST
description: A group of criminals carries out a carefully planned heist while facing intense pressure.
details: Money Heist (La Casa de Papel) is a Spanish crime drama centered around meticulously planned bank robberies led by The Professor. A group of code-named thieves target the Royal Mint of Spain and the Bank of Spain.

name: MY NAME
description: A determined woman joins a powerful crime organization to uncover the truth.
details: My Name follows a woman who joins a crime organization to uncover the truth behind her father's death, navigating loyalty, identity, and revenge.

name: TERRIFIER 3
description: Art the Clown returns to spread terror and chaos during the Christmas season.
details: Terrifier 3 is a 2024 independent supernatural slasher film. Art the Clown unleashes a gruesome rampage on Miles County during Christmas Eve while survivor Sienna Shaw returns to fight him.

name: INCEPTION
description: A skilled thief who steals secrets through dreams is given a chance to erase his past.
details: Inception follows a skilled thief who infiltrates targets' minds through shared dream technology to steal corporate secrets. He takes a final mission to plant an idea into a CEO's subconscious.

name: INTERSTELLAR
description: A group of explorers travels through a wormhole in space.
details: Interstellar (2014) is an epic sci-fi film directed by Christopher Nolan. Set in a dystopian future where Earth is dying, a group of NASA astronauts travel through a wormhole to find a new home for humanity.

name: THE DARK KNIGHT
description: Batman faces a dangerous criminal who creates chaos.
details: The Dark Knight (2008), directed by Christopher Nolan, follows Batman teaming up with James Gordon and Harvey Dent to dismantle Gotham's mob, only to face the Joker, an anarchist mastermind.

name: STRANGER THINGS
description: A group of friends uncover mysterious supernatural events in their small town.
details: Stranger Things follows a group of young friends in Hawkins whose lives change when a boy disappears and strange supernatural events begin. They discover a secret laboratory and a frightening alternate world called the Upside Down.

name: ALL OF US ARE DEAD
description: Students become trapped inside their school after a zombie outbreak begins.
details: All of Us Are Dead follows high school students trapped inside their school after a zombie outbreak. They must work together to survive while the outbreak spreads beyond the school.

name: HARRY POTTER
description: Harry Potter discovers that he is a young wizard and begins his journey at Hogwarts.
details: Harry Potter follows a young boy who discovers he is a wizard and is invited to Hogwarts. With friends Ron and Hermione, he faces dangerous challenges and the dark wizard Voldemort.

name: BREAKING BAD
description: A chemistry teacher turns to making illegal drugs after facing a serious personal crisis.
details: Breaking Bad tells the story of Walter White, a high school chemistry teacher who begins producing illegal drugs after a health diagnosis. He partners with Jesse Pinkman and enters the dangerous world of crime.

name: LUCIFER
description: Lucifer Morningstar leaves Hell and starts a new life in Los Angeles.
details: Lucifer follows Lucifer Morningstar, who leaves Hell and moves to Los Angeles. He becomes involved with detective Chloe Decker while helping solve unusual criminal cases.

name: PEAKY BLINDERS
description: The Shelby family runs a powerful criminal gang in post-war Birmingham.
details: Peaky Blinders follows the Shelby family and their powerful criminal organization in Birmingham after World War I. Tommy Shelby works to expand their influence while facing dangerous enemies.

name: PIRATES OF THE CARIBBEAN
description: Captain Jack Sparrow travels across the seas on dangerous pirate adventures.
details: Pirates of the Caribbean follows the adventures of Captain Jack Sparrow as he encounters rival pirates, cursed treasures, and supernatural forces.

name: RESIDENT EVIL
description: A deadly virus spreads across the world, creating terrifying monsters and chaos.
details: Resident Evil takes place in a world threatened by deadly viruses and terrifying creatures. Survivors struggle to stay alive while uncovering secrets behind powerful corporations and mysterious outbreaks.

name: SNOWPIERCER
description: Humanity's survivors live aboard a massive train after Earth becomes frozen.
details: Snowpiercer is set in a future where Earth has become frozen. The remaining survivors live aboard a massive train that constantly travels around the planet, divided by social class.

name: SQUID GAME
description: Hundreds of desperate contestants enter a mysterious competition for a huge cash prize.
details: Squid Game follows hundreds of people struggling financially who are invited to a mysterious competition. They soon discover that losing the games has deadly consequences.

name: THE WITCHER
description: Geralt of Rivia is a monster hunter who travels through a dangerous fantasy world.
details: The Witcher follows Geralt of Rivia, a skilled monster hunter. His destiny becomes connected with Princess Ciri and the powerful sorceress Yennefer in a larger conflict involving magic, politics, and war.

name: THE LINCOLN LAWYER
description: A skilled defense lawyer runs his legal practice from the back seat of his Lincoln.
details: The Lincoln Lawyer follows Mickey Haller, a talented defense attorney who runs his practice from the back seat of his Lincoln. He takes on difficult criminal cases while searching for the truth.

name: SUITS
description: A talented young man with a brilliant memory gets a job at a prestigious law firm.
details: Suits follows Mike Ross, a young man with an exceptional memory who gets a job at a prestigious law firm despite not having a law degree. He works with Harvey Specter while keeping his secret hidden.
